title.en: A slower first charge could speed up battery factories
title.zh: 第一次充慢一点，电池工厂反而更快

summary.en: Cornell and C4V report shorter battery formation protocols after observing protective layers in real time; factory-wide savings remain projections.
summary.zh: 康奈尔与C4V据报通过实时观察保护层，缩短电池化成流程；全厂节省仍属估计。

title.en: Who sets your price—and a driver’s pay?
title.zh: 谁在决定你的价格，也决定司机的报酬？

summary.en: The FTC orders nine firms to explain how personal data enters prices and compensation; the study is not a finding of wrongdoing.
summary.zh: FTC要求九家公司说明个人资料如何进入定价与报酬算法；调查并非违法认定。
